result.intro: your people in san antonio keep it simple: free walks, good light, and don't eat on the river walk. gabe's got you.

items.title: pearl at dusk
items.what: saturday ritual per gabe. ground fountains lit pink/blue, wet pavement reflections, old brewery chimney behind. free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave.
items.whyYou: made for your film brain — that portra 6:40pm reel? same slow dusk light, string lights + reflections.

evidence.caption: pearl at dusk. the ground fountains lit up, trees wrapped in string lights, a kid and a dog losing their minds in the spray, the old brewery chimney behind it all. saturday ritual. free to walk, $12 tacos if you cave #sanantonio #thepearl
evidence.sawLive: it's chill and not crowded, just a few families/kids by the fountains under the string lights. for december pics, the money details are the wet ground reflections, the pink/blue fountain spray, and the lit-up pearl chimney in the background.

items.title: mission san josé arches
items.what: long wall of stacked stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front. free national park. go cloudy morning for soft texture, light a candle.
items.whyYou: you're into art people + photographers — repeating arches and weathered stone are straight up design study.

evidence.caption: mission san josé with abuela on a cloudy sunday. the long wall of stone arches, two rows, green bushes in front, weathered like it's been there 300 years because it has. free. national park. she lit a candle and then made me drive her to h-e-b. spare room in southtown is open, she WILL cook for you
evidence.sawLive: two rows of weathered stone arches stacked over each other, with bright green bushes in front and a cloudy sky above. the soft, flat light brings out all the stone texture and repeating shapes, which is basically a photographer's dream.
